name: Falling-Light Drift
introDiscord: Falling lights drift through the trench like a permanent meteor shower. Shizuki's old notes reveal she treated every one as a potential wish.
introTwitch: Falling lights drift through the trench like a permanent meteor shower. Shizuki's old notes reveal she treated every one as a potential wish.

falling-light-drift-approach.prompt: Three routes glow beneath slowly falling lights.

left.message: Shizuki's tonic sits beside a list titled 'WISHES SO FAR: 47.' Number 12 is 'more berries.'
left.fullHpMessage: You leave the tonic and refrain from judging the wish priorities.

right.message: A Falling-Light Medusa descends among the false stars.

forward.message: A star-chart coffer glows beneath the meteor shower.

falling-light-drift-depths.prompt: The lights fall thicker as three paths disappear beneath them.

left.message:
A Berry sits beside Wish #31:

"Find unlimited berries.

This Berry does not count. I put it here."

right.message: A meteor-iron reliquary catches falling light like a tiny sun.

forward.message: A Falling-Light Medusa drifts directly into your route.

falling-light-drift-threshold.prompt: Rain of Silent Suns glows beyond the final three paths.

left.message: A Medusa descends silently from the lights.

right.message: Shizuki's bottle rests beside Wish #48: "Stop needing so many emergency bottles."
right.fullHpMessage: Wish #48 appears to be working for you.

forward.message:
"Star Candies sparkle inside a cometglass seam."

BOSS:

bossPromptDiscord:
The falling lights stop.

Then every one begins drifting toward the same enormous shape.

Use /yes to enter Rain of Silent Suns or /no to make your wish from significantly farther away.
bossPromptTwitch:
The falling lights stop.

Then every one begins drifting toward the same enormous shape.

Use !yes to enter Rain of Silent Suns or !no to make your wish from significantly farther away.
bossRetreatText:
You retreat beneath the falling lights.

You are permitted one emergency wish.

boss.revealText:
The lights gather into an enormous luminous bell.

Starshower Medusa reveals itself!

completionText:
"The Starshower disperses into harmless lights.

One falls beside you.

Wish carefully."
